data:
def WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation : {m : ℕ} → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ → Prop :=
fun {m} R => R.PosSemidef ∧ ∀ (i : Fin m), R i i = 1

def FSC.cdf : {n : ℕ} → FSC.Mat n → ℝ → ℝ :=
fun {n} G t => ((multivariateGaussian 0 G) (WeakSimplex.lowerOrthant t)).toReal
FSC.simplex_apply {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) : FSC.simplex n i j = if i = j then 1 else -1 / (↑n - 1)

FSCChecks.IndependentStatements.simplex_matrix_expanded {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
  FSC.simplex n = (1 / (↑n - 1)) • (↑n • 1 - Matrix.of fun x x_1 => 1)

FSCChecks.IndependentStatements.gaussian_event_expanded {n : ℕ} (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
  FSC.cdf G t = ((multivariateGaussian 0 G) {x | ∀ (i : Fin n), x.ofLp i ≤ t}).toReal

FSC.cdf_simplex_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (t : ℝ) :
  FSC.cdf (FSC.simplex n) t ≤ FSC.cdf G t

FSC.cdf_eq_simplex_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
  FSC.cdf G t = FSC.cdf (FSC.simplex n) t ↔ G = FSC.simplex n

FSC.cdf_simplex_lt {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
  (hne : G ≠ FSC.simplex n) : FSC.cdf (FSC.simplex n) t < FSC.cdf G t

FSCChecks.IndependentStatements.comparison_expanded {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
  (hPSD : G.PosSemidef) (hdiag : ∀ (i : Fin n), G i i = 1) (t : ℝ) :
  (multivariateGaussian 0 ((1 / (↑n - 1)) • (↑n • 1 - Matrix.of fun x x_1 => 1))) {x | ∀ (i : Fin n), x.ofLp i ≤ t} ≤
    (multivariateGaussian 0 G) {x | ∀ (i : Fin n), x.ofLp i ≤ t}

FSCChecks.IndependentStatements.equality_expanded {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
  (hPSD : G.PosSemidef) (hdiag : ∀ (i : Fin n), G i i = 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
  (multivariateGaussian 0 G) {x | ∀ (i : Fin n), x.ofLp i ≤ t} =
      (multivariateGaussian 0 ((1 / (↑n - 1)) • (↑n • 1 - Matrix.of fun x x_1 => 1)))
        {x | ∀ (i : Fin n), x.ofLp i ≤ t} ↔
    G = (1 / (↑n - 1)) • (↑n • 1 - Matrix.of fun x x_1 => 1)

FSCChecks.IndependentStatements.strict_comparison_expanded {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
  (hPSD : G.PosSemidef) (hdiag : ∀ (i : Fin n), G i i = 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
  (hne : G ≠ (1 / (↑n - 1)) • (↑n • 1 - Matrix.of fun x x_1 => 1)) :
  (multivariateGaussian 0 ((1 / (↑n - 1)) • (↑n • 1 - Matrix.of fun x x_1 => 1))) {x | ∀ (i : Fin n), x.ofLp i ≤ t} <
    (multivariateGaussian 0 G) {x | ∀ (i : Fin n), x.ofLp i ≤ t}

FSC.lowerOrthant_simplex_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (t : ℝ) :
  (multivariateGaussian 0 (FSC.simplex n)) (WeakSimplex.lowerOrthant t) ≤
    (multivariateGaussian 0 G) (WeakSimplex.lowerOrthant t)

FSC.coordinateMax_tail_lt_simplex {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (t : ℝ)
  (ht : 0 < t) (hne : G ≠ FSC.simplex n) :
  (multivariateGaussian 0 G) {x | t < WeakSimplex.coordinateMax ⋯ x} <
    (multivariateGaussian 0 (FSC.simplex n)) {x | t < WeakSimplex.coordinateMax ⋯ x}

FSC.coordinateMax_tail_eq_simplex_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (t : ℝ)
  (ht : 0 < t) :
  (multivariateGaussian 0 G) {x | t < WeakSimplex.coordinateMax ⋯ x} =
      (multivariateGaussian 0 (FSC.simplex n)) {x | t < WeakSimplex.coordinateMax ⋯ x} ↔
    G = FSC.simplex n

FSCChecks.IndependentStatements.tail_comparison_expanded {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
  (hPSD : G.PosSemidef) (hdiag : ∀ (i : Fin n), G i i = 1) (t : ℝ) :
  (multivariateGaussian 0 G) {x | ∃ i, t < x.ofLp i} ≤
    (multivariateGaussian 0 ((1 / (↑n - 1)) • (↑n • 1 - Matrix.of fun x x_1 => 1))) {x | ∃ i, t < x.ofLp i}

FSCChecks.IndependentStatements.strict_tail_comparison_expanded {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
  (hPSD : G.PosSemidef) (hdiag : ∀ (i : Fin n), G i i = 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
  (hne : G ≠ (1 / (↑n - 1)) • (↑n • 1 - Matrix.of fun x x_1 => 1)) :
  (multivariateGaussian 0 G) {x | ∃ i, t < x.ofLp i} <
    (multivariateGaussian 0 ((1 / (↑n - 1)) • (↑n • 1 - Matrix.of fun x x_1 => 1))) {x | ∃ i, t < x.ofLp i}

FSCChecks.IndependentStatements.tail_equality_expanded {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
  (hPSD : G.PosSemidef) (hdiag : ∀ (i : Fin n), G i i = 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
  (multivariateGaussian 0 G) {x | ∃ i, t < x.ofLp i} =
      (multivariateGaussian 0 ((1 / (↑n - 1)) • (↑n • 1 - Matrix.of fun x x_1 => 1))) {x | ∃ i, t < x.ofLp i} ↔
    G = (1 / (↑n - 1)) • (↑n • 1 - Matrix.of fun x x_1 => 1)
